## Summary
Build the mastery dashboard page with a radar chart showing per-USMLE-system mastery levels, backed by an API route that aggregates concept_mastery data by USMLE system.

## User story
As a student, I want to see a radar chart of my mastery across USMLE organ systems, so that I can quickly identify which systems I'm strong or weak in.

## Why this matters
Without a visual mastery dashboard, students have no way to understand their knowledge gaps. The radar chart is the primary entry point for the practice loop — it drives students to weak areas and motivates continued study.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] API route GET /api/mastery/[studentId] returns aggregated p_mastery per USMLE system
- [ ] API enforces RLS — students can only view their own mastery data
- [ ] Radar chart displays one axis per USMLE system with p_mastery values [0, 1]
- [ ] Systems with no data show as 0 (not missing from chart)
- [ ] Dashboard page renders in < 30 lines using template + MasteryRadarChart organism
- [ ] Responsive: works on mobile (fallback to bar chart below 640px if needed)
- [ ] Loading skeleton shown while mastery data fetches

## Schema changes
```sql
-- None — concept_mastery table created in E08-S01
-- View for aggregation by USMLE system:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.mastery_by_usmle_system AS
  SELECT
    cm.student_id,
    sc.usmle_system,
    AVG(cm.p_mastery) AS avg_mastery,
    COUNT(*) AS concept_count,
    SUM(cm.review_count) AS total_reviews
  FROM public.concept_mastery cm
  JOIN public.subconcepts sc ON sc.id = cm.concept_id
  GROUP BY cm.student_id, sc.usmle_system;
```

## API contract
```
GET /app/api/mastery/[studentId]
Headers: Authorization: Bearer [token]
Response 200: {
  data: {
    systems: [
      { system: "Cardiovascular", avg_mastery: 0.72, concept_count: 15, total_reviews: 45 },
      { system: "Respiratory", avg_mastery: 0.45, concept_count: 12, total_reviews: 20 },
      ...
    ],
    overall_mastery: 0.58,
    total_concepts: 120,
    mastered_count: 35
  },
  error: null
}
Response 401: { data: null, error: { code: 'UNAUTHORIZED', message: 'Not authenticated' } }
Response 403: { data: null, error: { code: 'FORBIDDEN', message: 'Cannot view other student mastery' } }
```

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// features/mastery-tracking/hooks/useMasteryDashboard.ts
import { createBrowserClient } from '@journey/db/client';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

export function useMasteryDashboard(studentId: string) {
  const [data, setData] = useState<MasteryDashboardData | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchMastery = async () => {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/mastery/${studentId}`);
      const { data } = await res.json();
      setData(data);
      setLoading(false);
    };
    fetchMastery();
  }, [studentId]);

  return { data, loading };
}

// app/(student)/mastery/page.tsx — must be < 30 lines
import { MasteryRadarChart } from '@/features/mastery-tracking';

export default function MasteryPage() {
  return <MasteryRadarChart />;
}
```

## Automated tests (Playwright — runs during /validate)
```typescript
// tests/E08/E08-S02.api.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test('GET /api/mastery/[studentId] returns 401 when not authenticated', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.get('/api/mastery/test-student-id');
  expect(res.status()).toBe(401);
});

test('GET /api/mastery/[studentId] returns mastery data for authenticated student', async ({ request }) => {
  const { token } = await getTestToken(request, 'student');
  const res = await request.get('/api/mastery/self', {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
  });
  expect(res.status()).toBe(200);
  const { data } = await res.json();
  expect(data.systems).toBeDefined();
  expect(Array.isArray(data.systems)).toBe(true);
  expect(data.overall_mastery).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
  expect(data.overall_mastery).toBeLessThanOrEqual(1);
});

// tests/E08/E08-S02.ui.test.ts
test('Mastery dashboard renders radar chart', async ({ page }) => {
  await loginAsStudent(page);
  await page.goto('/mastery');
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: /mastery/i })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="mastery-radar-chart"]')).toBeVisible();
});
```

## Rollback procedure

2. Remove files: features/mastery-tracking/*, app/api/mastery/*, app/(student)/mastery/*
3. `git stash && git checkout develop`
